title: Jim Steranko
description: JIM STERANKO, artist extraordinaire and magazine publisher, had the first comprehensive story and illustrations for the upcoming STAR WARS film in his magazine, then called Mediascene. Featured on the front of this card is the left half of a breathtaking Steranko painting based on THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK, which was designed for a wraparound cover. This image became the back cover of Mediascene; to see what the rest of the painting looks like (the right half, or "front cover"), check out card #81.
